दिधक्षा f. the wish to burn;
 a. ˚क्षु.

दिधिषूपति m. the husband of a woman married a second
time.
दी॑ध्यत् a. thinking, reflecting, thoughtful, attentive.
दी॑ध्यान a. thinking, reflecting, thoughtful, attentive.

दीधि दी॑ध्ये अ॑दीप्देत् pp. धीत॑ (q.v.) appear,
seem (A.);
 perceive, look at (acc.);
 think, consider (±मनसा),
desire. —अनु observe, think over. अभि think of, consider. आ
attend to, care for (gen.), make up one's mind. उद् look up to (acc.).
प्रति hope, expect. वि hesitate, be irresolute. — Cf. दी॑ध्यत् &
दी॑ध्यान.
